abstract: Choriocarcinoma is the most malignant tumor of gestational trophoblastic disease arising from any gestation. It has a tendency toward relapse as well as metastasis. Here, a case of relapsed high-risk choriocarcinoma (FIGO stage IV, WHO score 12) in a 37-year-old female presenting with vaginal bleedings is described. Relapse developed at the site of the surgical scar from hysterectomy that had been performed 2 years earlier. Although the patient was treated with aggressive chemotherapy, she was in a bad general condition and died from infection and liver insufficiency.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は、あらゆる妊娠に由来する妊娠性絨毛性疾患の中で最も悪性度の高い腫瘍です。再発と転移を起こしやすい傾向があります。本稿では、膣出血を呈した37歳女性に生じた、再発性の高リスク絨毛癌(FIGO病期IV、WHOスコア12)の症例を報告します。再発は2年前に施行された子宮摘出術の手術瘢痕部に生じました。積極的な化学療法を受けましたが、全身状態が不良であり、感染症と肝不全により死亡しました。
